author: Codex
basis: PROMPTS r2.13 section 4.5; established before corpus-content statistics

layout.section: SPDX License Identifier; Pragmas; Importing other Source Files

diagnostic_policy.standard_json: type/errorCode diagnostic probes only, never the compilation route
diagnostic_policy.verified_versions: populated only from recorded probes; document introduction versions do not imply empirically tested ranges

message_templates: Source <path> not found
categories.cause: Package is absent or no supplied mapping resolves its source-unit name.
categories.candidate_repair: deterministic: authorized offline package and version match; otherwise agent after dependency evidence
verification: D3: solc rc0, Slither construction, all input mappings, complete ContractDefinition coverage
D7: exact old-byte precondition, preserve source, per-file edit level, diagnostic-line restriction for rewrites, byte provenance and node marking
categories.cp4_operator: delete an imported package file

message_templates: Source <path> not found
categories.cause: Relative import target is absent from the approved project.
categories.candidate_repair: deterministic only with an unambiguous identity-checked existing dependency; otherwise agent
verification: D3: solc rc0, Slither construction, all input mappings, complete ContractDefinition coverage
D7: exact old-byte precondition, preserve source, per-file edit level, diagnostic-line restriction for rewrites, byte provenance and node marking
categories.cp4_operator: delete or rename a relative dependency

message_templates: Undeclared identifier|Identifier not found
categories.cause: A referenced declaration or scope is missing.
categories.candidate_repair: deterministic declaration-only stub when its complete type is constrained; otherwise agent

D7: exact old-byte precondition, preserve source, per-file edit level, diagnostic-line restriction for rewrites, byte provenance and node marking
categories.cp4_operator: delete a referenced declaration

categories.cause: A base declaration is absent, ambiguous, or ordered incorrectly.
